sentences.text: Pandrah din. Pandrah sau saintalis crore se upar ki kamaai, andaaze se.
Par is film ko banane wali company par? Paanch hazaar crore ka karza.
Ye Ramayana Part 1 ka haal hai. Aur theatre ki line aur bank ki line, ek jaisi nahi hoti.
To aaj film ki nahi, us company ki kahani. Ek garage, aath Oscar, ek strike, aur ek number jo aakhir mein sab badal deta hai.
Sirf business ki baat hogi. Na aastha, na acting.
Pehle ek chhoti si baat. Gross matlab ticket par kata hua poora paisa.
Net matlab tax hatane ke baad ka number. Aur producer ke haath mein jo aata hai, wo dono se alag hota hai, aur kam.
Saal unnees sau pachaanbe. Mumbai. Ek unnees saal ka ladka, Namit Malhotra, bank se loan leta hai.
Ek profile ke hisaab se, pehli company wahin shuru hui: ek garage mein.
Usi profile ke mutabik, is safar mein baadh, aag aur mandi, teeno aaye.
Aur ye baat baar baar lautegi: ye kaarobaar kabhi seedhi line mein nahi chalta.
Do hazaar aath. Mandi aayi, aur film industry mein strike.
Company bachi 3D conversion ke kaam se: purani aur nayi films ko 3D mein badalna.
3D conversion matlab, ek normal film ke har frame mein depth banana, taaki wo 3D screen par chale.
Pehla sabak: jab sab ruk jaye, tab bhi ek kaam chalta rehna chahiye.
Do hazaar chaudah. Prime Focus ka London ki ek VFX company, Double Negative, se merger.
Naam hua D Neg. Staff saat sau se badhkar, profile ke mutabik, lagbhag nau hazaar.
Phir Oscar. Inception, Interstellar, Ex Machina, Blade Runner 2049, First Man, Tenet, Dune.
Kul aath Oscar. Interstellar ke liye to ek asli black hole ka software bana, aur uske do research paper bhi chhape.
Sirf Dune Part Two mein, lagbhag ek hazaar VFX shots. Ye company ka apna bayaan hai.
Interstellar ke kuch frames render hone mein, reports ke hisaab se, sau ghante tak lage.
Isliye Oscar sirf award nahi hota. Wo bharose ka certificate hai, jo agle order mein badal jaata hai.
Ye hamara analysis hai.
Par VFX ek ajeeb business hai. Ye kaarkhaana hai, jahan sabse bada kharcha insaan hain.
Pichhle saal ka staff ka kharcha, lagbhag do hazaar aath sau pachaasi crore.
Upar se lagbhag paanch sau athaavan crore ka interest. Reports ke hisaab se.
Ek chhota udaaharan. Maan lijiye sau rupaye ki kamaai aayi.
Usmein se tehattar rupaye staff ki salary mein chale gaye, aur kuch interest mein. Bachta hai bahut kam.
Ab maan lijiye order aadhe ho gaye, par salary wahi rahi. Tab bachna door, kai baar ghaata ho jaata hai.
Ye sirf samjhane ke liye hai, asli company ke numbers nahi.
Jab order aate hain, to chaaron weight sambhal jaate hain. Jab order ruk jaye? Beam jhukta hai.
Do hazaar baais mein, ek SPAC ke raaste, lagbhag ek dashamlav saat billion dollar par listing ka plan bana, aur market ki halat dekhkar wapas le liya gaya.
Asli sabak: jahan kharcha pehle se fix ho, wahan order ka rukna sabse bada khatra hai.
Phir aayi do hazaar teis aur chaubees ki Hollywood strike. Writers aur actors, dono.
Shooting ruki, to post-production bhi ruk gaya.
Revenue lagbhag chaar hazaar chhah sau crore se girkar, teen hazaar nau sau pachaas ke aas paas aaya.
Aur ghaata, alag alag reports ke hisaab se, chaar sau pachaas se paanch sau crore ke beech.
Artists bench par. Software ke license chalu. Studio ka kiraya chalu.
Kaarkhaana khaali, par meter chalta raha.
Phir do hazaar pachchees mein Hollywood ka pipeline dobara khula.
Finshots ke hisaab se, pehli timahi mein revenue teis percent badhkar, lagbhag nau sau chhihattar crore hua. Pichhle saal ke ghaate ki jagah, lagbhag ek sau das crore ka munafa aaya.
Poore saal mein company ne lagbhag teen sau ek crore ka munafa dikhaya. Wahi bench, jo pehle dhakel rahe the, ab margin badhane lage.
Aise waqt mein zyadatar company kharcha ghatati hai. Prime Focus ne doosra raasta chuna.
Do hazaar chaubees ke July mein, D Neg ne Prime Focus Technologies chhah sau tiraanve crore mein kharidi.
Matlab: studios ab alag alag vendor nahi chahte. Jo ek hi jagah effects bhi banaye, aur content ko streaming ke liye taiyaar bhi kare, uski keemat badhti hai.
Aur phir ek aur daav: apni khud ki film.
Yahi hai Ramayana. Ab tak ye company doosron ki films ke effects banati thi, yaani kiraye ka kaam. Ab wo makaan maalik bhi banna chahti hai.
Makers ke hisaab se, do hisson ka budget lagbhag chaar hazaar crore.
Alag trade reports Part 1 ke liye sola sau se do hazaar crore ka andaaza deti hain, aur ek shuruaati report aath sau paintees se nau sau. Budget ka number khud ek paheli hai.
Kiraye par kaam karne wale ki kamaai tab tak, jab tak order aata hai. Makaan maalik ki kamaai film ke saath saalon tak chal sakti hai: theatre, OTT, music, aur Part 2.
Par makaan banane ka kharcha pehle dena padta hai. Aur wahi karze ka sawaal wapas laata hai.
Ye daav pehle bhi lag chuka hai. Do hazaar teis mein Adipurush.
Reports ke hisaab se budget paanch se saat sau crore, VFX par online aalochna, makers ne kaam dobara kiya, aur ek trade estimate ke mutabik lagbhag do sau pachchees crore ka ghaata.
Ye kisi film ka mazaak nahi. Bas ye dikhana hai ki is zameen par VFX ka daav kitna jokhim bhara hota hai.
Is baar tech par poora zor. Filmed for IMAX.
Cinematographer ke mutabik, motion capture floor par lagbhag bayaalees infrared cameras, aur Jatayu poori tarah CG.
Trailer kai delay ke baad tees July do hazaar chhabbees ko aaya. Plan tha: Part 1 Diwali do hazaar chhabbees, Part 2 Diwali do hazaar sattaees.
Do hisson mein banane ka faayda: sets, assets aur technology ek baar ban kar dono mein chalte hain. Par risk bhi bada: Part 1 ki kamaai se Part 2 ka bharosa judta hai.
Ab dhyaan se sunna.
Pehla number: pandrah din mein, Sacnilk ke estimate ke mutabik, duniya bhar ka gross, lagbhag pandrah sau saintalis crore.
Doosra: Part 1 ka budget, andaaze se, sola sau se do hazaar crore. Teesra: Prime Focus ka gross karza, lagbhag paanch hazaar crore.
Par gross wo paisa hai, jo ticket par kata. Usmein se tax, theatre ka hissa aur distributor ka hissa nikalta hai.
Producer tak kitna pahunchta hai, ye exact split public nahi. Isliye pandrah sau crore ko kamaai kehna galat hoga. Ye ticket ki keemat hai.
Ab teeno ko saath rakhte hain. Agar budget sola sau se do hazaar crore ke beech hai, to gross ne pandrah din mein budget ke lagbhag barabar ka number chhoo liya.
Par us gross ka sirf ek hissa producer tak jaata hai. Aur karze ka square? Wo abhi bhi sabse bada hai.
Hindi version akela, The Week ke mutabik, lagbhag chhah sau pachaas crore net par pahuncha.
Ab ek aur parat. Finshots ke mutabik Ranbir Kapoor ne Prime Focus mein pandrah crore rupaye khud lagaaye.
Matlab film mein ek aadmi do jagah baitha hai: parde par, aur shareholder ke roop mein.
Do hazaar pachchees ke September mein, Madhusudan Kela aur Utpal Sheth jaise nivesh ne milkar, lagbhag teen dashamlav teen percent hissa kharida.
Share bazaar ne daav ko pehle hi daam mein daal diya: trailer ke mahine mein paintees percent, aur ek saal mein lagbhag attanve percent ki badhat.
Jab ummeedein pehle se daam mein hon, to kabhi kabhi badi safalta bhi kaafi nahi lagti.
Ye mera analysis hai, investment salaah nahi. Ek aalochak ka manna ye bhi hai ki marketing film se zyada studio ko bech rahi hai. Dekhna ye hai ki sach kya nikalta hai.
Unnees sau pachaanbe mein, bank loan se kharide computer. Do hazaar chhabbees mein, ek film jo IMAX ke liye shoot hui.
Daav ka size badla, par sawaal wahi: jab order ruke, tab bhi kya kaarkhaana chalta rahega?
Aur ye kahani sirf ek company ki nahi, ek tareeke ki hai. Jo kaam kiraye par karta hai, wo dheere dheere makaan banane ki taraf badhta hai.
Isme jeet bhi badi hoti hai, aur girna bhi.
Part 2 ke liye teen cheezein dekhna. Ek: company ke results mein film ki kamaai kab aur kitni dikhti hai.
Do: karze ka number kitna ghatta hai. Teen: Hollywood ke orders kitne aate hain. Reports ke hisaab se Part 2 Diwali do hazaar sattaees mein hai.
Agar business ko is tarah dekhna pasand aaya, to nerdlogic dot co ko follow aur subscribe karein.
Aur ye video us dost ko bhejiye, jo gross ko hi kamaai samajhta hai.
